user.title: Lena
user.description: Adds Lena's feelings, her memory list and her tools. Afterwards, open Configure to tell her about your house, then tick Lena under Control Home Assistant in your Ollama conversation agent.

init.title: Lena
init.description: Who she misses, what she notices, her day, and who she tells when something's wrong. Her feelings' descriptions are in feelings.yaml in the integration's folder.

data.empty_hours: Lonely after the house is empty for
data.mood_change_chance: Chance per hour a mood moves on
data.alert_phones: Tell these phones when she's worried
data.alert_agent: Write alerts in her words with
data.alert_all_clear: Also tell them when it's sorted

data_description.people: Coming home after a while makes her delighted; an empty house makes her restless.
data_description.weather: Rain, storms, snow and sunshine colour her mood.
data_description.special_days: Birthdays, anniversaries or holidays: anything on these today puts her in a good mood.
data_description.worries: Problem sensors she frets about while they're on: leaks, smoke, a door or garage left open.
data_description.mood_change_chance: Once a mood has lasted long enough.
data_description.moment_minutes: How long a reaction, like being pleased or exasperated, lasts.
data_description.alert_phones: Phones with the Home Assistant companion app. Tapping the alert opens the Lena app, listening.
data_description.alert_agent: Your Lena conversation agent. She writes each alert herself; leave empty to send the plain reason instead.
data_description.alert_all_clear: A second alert when the sensor clears, replacing the first.

feel.name: Feel
feel.description: Sets how something just made Lena feel. It fades on its own after a few minutes.

moment.name: Moment
moment.description: One of her moments in feelings.yaml, for example Pleased or Exasperated.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: What happened, in a few words, written to her.

add_event.name: Add event
add_event.description: Adds an event to a calendar exposed to Assist, the way Lena does when asked. Open WebUI's Lena tool uses it.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: The calendar's name as shown in Home Assistant. Can be left out when only one calendar can take events.

start.name: Start
start.description: A date (2026-11-14) for an all-day event, or a date and time (2026-11-14T15:30), in the house's time zone.

end.name: End
end.description: For an all-day event, the last day; for a timed event, when it ends. Without it: one day, or one hour.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Says a message on Lena's displays (the Lena app on a tablet or phone), like Home Assistant Voice's announcements.

device_id.name: Displays
device_id.description: The Lena displays to say it on. Leave empty for all of them.

listen.name: Listen for an answer
listen.description: After saying it, she listens, and answers what you say back.
